answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the horizon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
